market.unit: Detected live store domains, not unique businesses or paying customers
market.method: Indicative TAM = observed live stores × assumed 10% qualification × assumed $99/month × 12. Initial Shopify SAM uses the Shopify subset and the same assumptions. Deduplication, qualification and willingness to pay remain unvalidated. TAM is software revenue opportunity, not GMV. Neither estimate is a forecast.
market.discrepancy: The Shopify detail page showed 3,163,100 while the aggregate report showed 3,163,099. The model consistently uses the aggregate snapshot. This one-domain difference does not affect rounded figures.

sources.title: Store Leads: The State of Ecommerce in 2026
sources.supports: 14,005,842 detected live stores and 3,163,099 Shopify stores. Third-party crawl, not official merchant census.

sources.title: Shopify FY2025 Form 10-K
sources.supports: FY2025 GMV of $378,441 million. Context only, excluded from software TAM and not shown as RunMyStore traction.

sources.title: Shopify Community: Admin and sidekick slow to respond
sources.author: Central_Hobbies
sources.excerpt: It takes several seconds to over a minute for anything I do on the admin page or sidekick to respond.
sources.supports: One merchant's self-reported admin latency. Not a measured benchmark or proof of a platform-wide defect.

sources.title: Reddit: I feel like it's all getting too much
sources.author: u/aylin-97
sources.supports: A merchant describes separate apps, dependence on integrations and unexpectedly high total costs. Anecdote, not prevalence data.

sources.title: Shopify Help: Improving your online store performance
sources.supports: Themes, apps and media can affect storefront performance. Shopify also supplies global hosting, CDN and image optimization. Storefront performance and admin latency are different.

sources.title: Shopify Help: Sidekick
sources.supports: Uses store data, executes multi-step tasks, presents changes for review, builds Flow workflows and creates content. RunMyStore cannot claim these capabilities are unique.

sources.title: AdCreative.ai
sources.supports: AI ad creative generation, video and creative scoring. Vendor capability description, no independent effectiveness claim.

sources.title: Klaviyo: AI marketing platform
sources.supports: Customer data, marketing automation and ecommerce integrations. Vendor capability description, no independent effectiveness claim.

sources.title: RunMyStore prototype source
sources.supports: Frontend-only catalog, website, ads, campaigns, budgets and local approvals. AI and AgenticOrg execution are simulated.

socialCards.disclosure: Illustrative posts. Fictional merchants, invented wording, no real handles, engagement counts or endorsements. These are not X screenshots or evidence.
